name: ComboBox
description: A text field that filters a menu of options.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.

variant.description: secondary is for a field on a grey surface.

fullWidth.description: false takes the natural field width token.

defaultSelectedKey.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

selectedKey.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

defaultInputValue.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

inputValue.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. Pair it with isReadOnly.

menuTrigger.description: focus shows the options before typing.

allowsCustomValue.description: Keeps typed text that matches no option.

onInputChange.description: The text, as typed: filter on the server.
